SELECT lineitem.l_shipmode AS lineitem_l_shipmode, sum(CASE WHEN (orders.o_orderpriority = :o_orderpriority_1 OR orders.o_orderpriority = :o_orderpriority_2) THEN :param_1 ELSE :param_2 END) AS high_line_count, sum(CASE WHEN (orders.o_orderpriority != :o_orderpriority_3 AND orders.o_orderpriority != :o_orderpriority_4) THEN :param_3 ELSE :param_4 END) AS low_line_count 
FROM lineitem, orders 
WHERE orders.o_orderkey = lineitem.l_orderkey AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN (:l_shipmode_1_1, :l_shipmode_1_2) AND lineitem.l_commitdate < lineitem.l_receiptdate AND lineitem.l_shipdate < lineitem.l_commitdate AND lineitem.l_receiptdate >= :l_receiptdate_1 AND lineitem.l_receiptdate < :l_receiptdate_2 GROUP BY lineitem.l_shipmode ORDER BY lineitem.l_shipmode

statements.sql:
SELECT l_shipmode,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) high_line_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH'
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) low_line_count
FROM orders, lineitem
WHERE o_orderkey = l_orderkey
  AND l_shipmode IN (:b0, :b1)
  AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
  AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate
  AND l_receiptdate >= :b2
  AND l_receiptdate < :b3
GROUP BY l_shipmode
ORDER BY l_shipmode
